hooks.command: sh -c 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-5; export ANTHROPIC_MODEL; if [ -x node_modules/.bin/probity ]; then node_modules/.bin/probity --agent claude-code; else npx --yes @nizos/probity@1.8.1 --agent claude-code; fi'

hooks.rewakeMessage: RoboRev flagged the last commit (FAIL). Two steps, BOTH mandatory, in order: (1) handle the finding — fix it, or judge it wrong/intentional; (2) BEFORE your next commit, run: roborev respond <job> -m '<what you did and why>' && roborev close <job>. A fix commit that cites the review number does NOT close it — only the close command does. Leave a review open ONLY if it is deliberately deferred or needs the operator. Max 2 fix rounds per finding-surface (a genuinely NEW defect resets the counter), then stop fixing: escalate, or decline by judgment with recorded reasoning surfaced to the human. Finding follows:
